en.title: Netflix UK Drops Festive Classics: Your 2026 Christmas Movie Lineup Revealed
en.summary: Get ready for a serious dose of holiday cheer! Netflix UK has unveiled its stacked lineup of licensed Christmas classics arriving this November and December.
en.body:
The festive season is officially kicking into high gear, and **Netflix UK** has just delivered the gift that keeps on giving: its full slate of licensed Christmas classics for late 2026. Forget scrambling for what to watch; the streaming giant is ensuring subscribers have a treasure trove of holiday heavyweights at their fingertips throughout November and December. This year's lineup leans heavily into beloved films from the last few decades, promising double doses of Grinchy mischief and heartwarming, tear-jerking moments.

## Your 2026 Holiday Movie Marathon Starts Now

**Netflix UK** has pulled out the big guns, securing rights to some of the most iconic Christmas movies that have defined holiday viewing for generations. Kicking off the festivities on November 1st is **A Very Harold & Kumar Christmas**, offering a distinctly adult take on holiday chaos. Just a few days later, on November 5th, **Christmas at the Palace** arrives, likely bringing royal intrigue and festive romance. The beloved Grinch makes a double appearance, with the live-action **How the Grinch Stole Christmas** (starring **Jim Carrey**) landing on November 10th, followed by Illumination's animated **Dr. Seuss’ The Grinch** (featuring the voice of **Benedict Cumberbatch**) on November 15th. Fans of Santa's less famous sibling will be delighted by **Fred Claus**, starring **Vince Vaughn** and **Paul Giamatti**, arriving on November 12th. This curated selection ensures that whether you're craving zany comedy or a touch of sentimental magic, your holiday viewing schedule is comprehensively covered.

## Nostalgia and New Traditions for Fans

For dedicated fans, this announcement solidifies **Netflix UK**'s commitment to providing a robust holiday viewing experience that blends established favorites with their growing slate of originals. The inclusion of these licensed classics isn't just about filling the schedule; it's about tapping into the deep well of nostalgia that fuels holiday traditions. For many, watching **The Polar Express** or **Love Actually** is as essential to Christmas as decorating the tree. By making these films readily available, **Netflix** ensures that binge-watchers and casual viewers alike can easily access the films that create lasting memories. The anticipation builds each year as subscribers await confirmation of these holiday staples, and **Netflix UK**'s early reveal allows fans to plan their festive movie marathons well in advance, fostering a sense of community around shared viewing experiences.

## What's Next

Subscribers can expect the full list of **Netflix UK**'s 2026 holiday originals to be announced soon, complementing this impressive collection of licensed classics. The festive films will begin rolling out on November 1st, with new titles arriving throughout November and December.

content_raw: Picture Credit: Universal Pictures With the festive season just around the corner, Netflix UK has officially pulled back the curtain on its festive programming slate for late 2026. Alongside a brand-new crop of Netflix Originals, subscribers in the United Kingdom are set to receive an absolute treasure trove of licensed holiday heavyweights—from The Polar Express to Love Actually . We’ve already rounded up the licensed Christmas movies heading to Netflix in the United States , as well as our complete preview of the Netflix 2026 global original holiday lineup . Now, it’s the UK’s turn to shine, with Netflix securing the rights to some of the biggest and best-loved Christmas classics of the last three decades. Here is your full breakdown of everything festive arriving on Netflix UK across November and December 2026. The Big Licensed Christmas Movies Coming to Netflix UK Netflix UK always tends to pull out the big guns for licensed festive titles, but 2026 is shaping up to be one of the best years in recent memory. Whether you fancy double-dosing on Grinch movies or crying your eyes out at London airport arrivals, you’re well covered. A Very Harold & Kumar Christmas (2011) – Arriving November 1st Christmas at the Palace (2018) – Arriving November 5th How the Grinch Stole Christmas (2000) – Arriving November 10th Jim Carrey dons the green prosthetic makeup for Ron Howard’s cult 2000 live-action adaptation of Dr. Seuss’ beloved story. Fred Claus (2007) – Arriving November 12th Vince Vaughn stars as Santa’s bitter older brother Fred, forced to work at the North Pole alongside Paul Giamatti. Dr. Seuss’ The Grinch (2018) – Arriving November 15th Illumination’s animated take on the Whoville curmudgeon, featuring the voice talents of Benedict Cumberbatch. Christmas in Scotland (2023) – Arriving November 25th A Very English Christmas (2023) – Arriving November 25th The Holiday (2006) – Arriving December 2nd Nancy Meyers’ quintessential rom-com starring Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law, and Jack Black trading homes between sunny LA and snowy Surrey. Love Actually (2003) – Arriving December 3rd Richard Curtis’ star-studded British ensemble that follows nine intertwined stories exploring the complexities of love across London. Last Christmas (2019) – Arriving December 11th Emilia Clarke and Henry Golding lead this London-set rom-com soundtracked entirely by the music of George Michael and Wham!. Picture: Warner Bros. The Polar Express (2004) – Arriving December 14th Robert Zemeckis’ motion-capture journey to the North Pole featuring Tom Hanks in a multitude of roles. Netflix UK has also confirmed it will be receiving the family features Lumo: The Lapland Reindeer and the brand-new iteration of Barbie in the Nutcracker over the festive window. Note: The British seasonal staple Nativity! is also streaming on Netflix UK right now.
